knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: 以 RFC 8985 的「RACK-TLP」作具名案例，研究以下介面或演算法：RACK利用已確認資料的傳送時間推論遺失；重排序窗口避免把所有晚到封包當遺失。 本課從明示的離線資料建立證據，不要求接觸營運網路。
knowledge.textEn: Use RFC 8985 as the named primary case for RACK-TLP: time-based reordering tolerance. RACK uses transmission times of acknowledged data to infer loss; a reordering window prevents treating every late packet as lost. Build evidence from explicit offline fixtures without accessing operational networks.
